mapper.select: select setting.sys_id, setting.call_cd, setting.call_nm, setting.single_yn, setting.description from consumer_staff_call_setting setting where setting.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} order by setting.insert_datetime asc, setting.sys_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into consumer_staff_call ( sys_id, call_cd, description, read_yn, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd ) values ( #{sysId}, #{callCd}, #{description}, 'N', now(), #{sysPlantCd} )
